_about: Probe scenarios for tools/test/run.py probe. Each runs the game headless (banished --boot-capture) with these arguments, records the --probe answers and compares them with tools/test/baselines/<name>.json. Times are seconds of game capture time; the capture is 1280x720. See docs/develop/TESTING.md.
